headline: Drones Strike Two Russian Military Cargo Vessels in Baltic and Libya
summary: Two US-sanctioned Russian RoRo cargo ships used for military transport were struck by drones in the Gulf of Finland and at Libya's Benghazi port within 24 hours.
why: Maritime disruptions to state-linked commercial fleets heighten risks and insurance premiums across strategic shipping corridors.

impacts.name: Russia
impacts.why: Attacks on military logistical shipping limit state sea line maintenance capabilities.
